author: deme1744
content:
Thanks. Yes, I've catched up with that discussion and PRs. The move to lazily "on-demand" fetching sounds reasonable. One could add clutter data in the witness anyway, this wasn't covered before either. So some other check would be needed if we want this.

Our implementation still walks every node reachable from the root that is in the witness eagerly. But that's is ok as with a proper root that would just cover the correct nodes anyhow. I'll probably change it in the future but it is a bit more of an invasive change. For now I've added the structural checks to pass the fixtures, these should be rather cheap compared to the rest I think.
